name: eng-2194

cases.title: Each Only button sizes to its label at the right edge of its row

steps.why: hover Claim so its Only button shows

cases.proves: Done When 1: The Only button stays compact and right-aligned when a node-type row is hovered, with no stretching or layout shift.
cases.caption: In the node summoning menu's type filter, the Only button now fits its label and sits at the right edge of each row, instead of taking half the row.

expect.js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48 .bp3-menu-item')).filter(proof.visible); proof.assert(rows.length >= 4, 'Expected at least 4 type rows, found ' + rows.length + '.'); for (const row of rows) { const only = proof.byText('button', 'Only', row); proof.assert(only, 'A type row has no Only button.'); const box = proof.rect(only); const style = getComputedStyle(row); const contentRight = proof.rect(row).right - parseFloat(style.paddingRight) - parseFloat(style.borderRightWidth); const edge = contentRight - box.right; proof.assert(box.width < 100, 'The Only button is ' + Math.round(box.width) + 'px wide; it should fit its label.'); proof.assert(Math.abs(edge) <= 2, 'The Only button sits ' + Math.round(edge) + 'px inside the row content edge.'); } })()

wait for the menu to close
start from an empty scratch page

do.js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48 .bp3-menu-item')).filter(proof.visible); window.__pk2194 = { idle: rows.map((r) => ({ opacity: parseFloat(getComputedStyle(proof.byText('button', 'Only', r)).opacity), height: Math.round(proof.rect(r).height) })) }; })()

steps.why: note each row's Only opacity and height before any hover
move the mouse off the row

cases.intent: Open the node search menu by typing the trigger in a block, click the filter icon, then move the mouse over each type row and away from it.

expect.js: (() => { const s = window.__pk2194; proof.assert(s && s.idle.length >= 4, 'No measurements from before the hover.'); s.idle.forEach((i, n) => { proof.assert(i.opacity < 0.01, 'The Only button on row ' + (n + 1) + ' showed with no hover.'); }); proof.assert(s.hovered > 0.99, 'The Only button did not show on hover.'); const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48 .bp3-menu-item')).filter(proof.visible); rows.forEach((r, n) => { proof.assert(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(proof.byText('button', 'Only', r)).opacity) < 0.01, 'The Only button on row ' + (n + 1) + ' stayed visible after the mouse left.'); proof.assert(Math.abs(Math.round(proof.rect(r).height) - s.idle[n].height) <= 1, 'Row ' + (n + 1) + ' changed height.'); }); })()

cases.caption: Only stays hidden until you hover a row, fades in on that row, and fades out when the mouse leaves.
cases.checks: Only is invisible on every row at rest, fully visible on the hovered row, invisible again after the mouse leaves, and no row changes height.

cases.intent: With the filter list open, compare each type row's height and spacing while hovered and not hovered. Scroll the list if there are more than 6 types.

expect.js: (() => { const s = window.__pk2194; proof.assert(s && s.during, 'No measurements.'); const list = document.querySelector('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48'); const after = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48 .bp3-menu-item')).filter(proof.visible).map((r) => Math.round(proof.rect(r).height)); proof.assert(s.idle.length >= 4 && s.idle.length === s.during.rows.length && s.idle.length === after.length, 'The number of rows changed.'); s.idle.forEach((h, n) => { proof.assert(Math.abs(s.during.rows[n] - h) <= 1, 'Row ' + (n + 1) + ' went from ' + h + 'px to ' + s.during.rows[n] + 'px on hover.'); proof.assert(Math.abs(after[n] - h) <= 1, 'Row ' + (n + 1) + ' did not return to ' + h + 'px.'); }); proof.assert(s.idleList[0] === s.during.list[0] && s.idleList[1] === s.during.list[1], 'The list size changed on hover: ' + s.idleList.join('/') + ' to ' + s.during.list.join('/') + '.'); proof.assert(list.scrollHeight === s.idleList[1], 'The list scroll height changed.'); })()

cases.caption: Hovering rows does not change their height, and the list does not jump or grow a scrollbar.
cases.checks: Every row keeps its height and the list keeps its height and scroll height while rows are hovered and after the mouse leaves.

surface.why: Only calls handleSelectOnly and closes the filter panel, which changes which result groups render and the active index used by arrow keys and Enter.

surface.area: Filter by Type panel header and Select all
surface.why: It shares the filter panel with the Only buttons, and the Only/Select all state interplay (isAllSelected) decides the Select all button label and colour.
The menu is opened by the personal trigger configured in Personal settings, so the menu must still open from a custom trigger and render the filter the same way.

surface.area: Roam light/dark theme styling of the filter menu
surface.why: Removing the !rounded-none and !h-full overrides leaves Blueprint's hover, focus and corner styling in charge, which can look different in Roam's dark theme or on a long type name.
